import sys, json, pathlib, traceback
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
OUT=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
(OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
print('SPEC',json.dumps(r.spec()),flush=True)
cams=['head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1']
n=0
obs=None
def record(res):
 global n,obs
 obs=res
 d=OUT/f'run_{n:03d}'
 res.save(str(d))
 panel=Image.new('RGB',(960,520))
 draw=ImageDraw.Draw(panel)
 for i,(c,im) in enumerate(res.last.items()):
  x=(i%3)*320;y=(i//3)*260
  panel.paste(Image.fromarray(im),(x,y+20));draw.text((x+5,y+3),c,fill='white')
 panel.save(OUT/'latest.jpg')
 print('RESULT',n,json.dumps(res.meta),flush=True)
 n+=1
record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,include_depth=True))
for line in sys.stdin:
 try:
  cmd=json.loads(line)
  with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(cmd)+'\n')
  if cmd['op']=='observe':
   record(r.get_obs(cameras=cams,seconds=cmd.get('seconds',0),include_depth=True))
  elif cmd['op']=='ee':
   p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][14:28]).reshape(2,7)
   g=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][28:30])
   for i,key in enumerate(['left','right']):
    if key in cmd:
     arm=cmd[key]
     if 'q' in arm:p[i,3:]=arm['q']
     if 'xyz' in arm:p[i,:3]=arm['xyz']
     if 'tcp' in arm:
      q=p[i,3:];rot=Rotation.from_quat([q[1],q[2],q[3],q[0]])
      p[i,:3]=np.array(arm['tcp'])-rot.apply([0.12,0,0])
     if 'g' in arm:g[i]=arm['g']
   a=np.concatenate([p[0],[g[0]],p[1],[g[1]]])
   print('TARGET',a.tolist(),flush=True)
   record(r.submit('ee_pose',a,cameras=cams,video='mp4',include_depth=True,note=cmd.get('note','')))
  elif cmd['op']=='grip':
   a=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:14]);b=a.copy()
   for i,key in [(6,'left'),(13,'right')]:
    if key in cmd:b[i]=cmd[key]
   rows=np.linspace(a,b,21)
   rows=np.concatenate([rows,np.tile(b,(10,1))])
   record(r.submit('joint_position',rows,dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='mp4',include_depth=True,note=cmd.get('note','')))
  elif cmd['op']=='joint':
   a=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:14]);b=np.array(cmd['target'])
   record(r.submit('joint_position',np.linspace(a,b,cmd.get('steps',61)),dt=.05,cameras=cams,video='mp4',include_depth=True))
  elif cmd['op']=='quit':break
 except Exception:
  traceback.print_exc()
